text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm? Well, who knows?
I'm just not really feeling it today~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: "I'll be fine. Precisely because I lack motivation, my head stays sharp trying to find the easiest way to win."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
For example... skillfully trapping your opponent
in our strategy to take the win.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
And fortunately for Sei-chan,
everything on that front is already prepared. Hehehe.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, you should loosen up too, Trainer.
Just sit back and take it easy.
